Subject: a massive piledriver gauntlet with one large fault-line crack beneath its knuckles. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
